question: 按车型统计车辆平均载重
query: SELECT t.type_name AS vehicle_type, AVG(v.load_capacity) AS avg_load FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code GROUP BY v.vehicle_type_code;

question: 统计各驾照状态驾驶员数量
query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM transportation.driver GROUP BY status;

question: 统计所有危化品车辆数量
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS hazmat_count FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE t.type_name = '危化品车';

question: 统计座位数大于30的客车数量
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS large_bus_count FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE t.type_name = '客车' AND v.seat_count > 30;

question: 查询所有重型货车
query: SELECT plate_number, load_capacity FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE t.type_name = '货车' AND v.load_capacity > 15;

question: 统计车辆总数
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM transportation.vehicle;

question: 统计所有船舶的最大航速平均值和最大值
query: SELECT AVG(max_speed) AS avg_speed, MAX(max_speed) AS max_speed FROM transportation.vessel;

question: 统计所有轻型车的数量
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS light_vehicle_count FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE load_capacity <= 5;

question: 查询山东省注册的车辆总数
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE area_id LIKE '37%';

question: 查询陕西省注册的车辆总数
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE area_id LIKE '61%';

question: 查询所有船舶中，最大航速为NULL的船舶
query: SELECT mmsi FROM transportation.vessel WHERE max_speed IS NULL;

question: 查询所有驾驶员中性别为'女'且驾照状态为'正常'的
query: SELECT name FROM transportation.driver WHERE gender='女' AND status='正常';

question: 查询所有车辆中座位数大于50的车辆
query: SELECT plate_number, seat_count FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE seat_count > 50;

question: 查询所有船舶公司员工中状态为在职的
query: SELECT name FROM transportation.employee WHERE status = '在职';

question: 查询所有2022年注册的车辆
query: SELECT plate_number FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE YEAR(register_date) = 2022;

question: 查询所有船舶公司员工中姓名以李开头的
query: SELECT name FROM transportation.employee WHERE name LIKE '李%';

question: 查询所有船舶中，自持力不为空的船舶
query: SELECT mmsi, endurance FROM transportation.vessel WHERE endurance IS NOT NULL;

question: 查询所有驾驶员的姓名和驾龄，驾龄按领证日期计算
query: SELECT name, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, issue_date, CURDATE()) AS driving_years FROM transportation.driver;

question: 统计各公司拥有座位数大于30的客车数量
query: SELECT c.company_name, COUNT(v.vehicle_id) AS large_bus_count FROM transportation.vehicle_company c JOIN transportation.vehicle v ON c.company_id = v.company_id JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE t.type_name = '客车' AND v.seat_count > 30 GROUP BY c.company_id;

question: 统计每个船舶公司的员工总数
query: SELECT sc.company_name, COUNT(e.employee_id) AS employee_count FROM transportation.shipping_company sc LEFT JOIN transportation.employee e ON sc.company_id = e.company_id GROUP BY sc.company_id;

question: 统计每个公司车辆的平均注册年份
query: SELECT c.company_name, AVG(YEAR(v.register_date)) AS avg_reg_year FROM transportation.vehicle_company c JOIN transportation.vehicle v ON c.company_id = v.company_id GROUP BY c.company_id;

question: 统计每个船舶公司的船舶最大载重总和
query: SELECT sc.company_name, SUM(v.max_load) AS total_load_capacity FROM transportation.shipping_company sc JOIN transportation.vessel v ON sc.company_id = v.company_id GROUP BY sc.company_id ORDER BY total_load_capacity DESC;

question: 统计每个品牌拥有的不同型号数量，按数量降序排列
query: SELECT brand, COUNT(DISTINCT model) AS model_count FROM transportation.vehicle GROUP BY brand ORDER BY model_count DESC;

question: 统计东北三省各城市的车辆数量
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,4) AS city_code, COUNT(*) FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE LEFT(area_id,2) IN ('21','22','23') GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,4) ORDER BY city_code;

question: 统计北京市各品牌车辆的数量
query: SELECT brand, COUNT(*) FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE area_id LIKE '11%' GROUP BY brand ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

question: 查询每个城市的车辆数并取前10
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,4) AS city_code, COUNT(*) FROM transportation.vehicle GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,4) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10;

question: 统计东北三省货车的数量
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS northeast_truck_count FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE LEFT(v.area_id,2) IN ('21','22','23') AND t.type_name = '货车';

question: 查询所有强制性报废车辆
query: SELECT v.plate_number, v.manufacture_year FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE t.type_name = '货车' AND YEAR(CURDATE()) - v.manufacture_year > 15;

question: 查询湖南省所有座位数大于40的客车
query: SELECT plate_number, seat_count FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE v.area_id LIKE '43%' AND t.type_name = '客车' AND v.seat_count > 40;

question: 查询陕西省所有注册超过15年的货车
query: SELECT v.plate_number FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE v.area_id LIKE '61%' AND t.type_name = '货车' AND YEAR(CURDATE()) - v.manufacture_year > 15;

question: 查询青岛市注册的所有货车
query: SELECT plate_number FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE v.area_id LIKE '3702%' AND t.type_name='货车';

question: 查询所有黑色且为货车的车辆
query: SELECT plate_number FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE v.color = '黑' AND t.type_name = '货车';

question: 查询江苏省所有座位数大于50的客车及其公司
query: SELECT v.plate_number, c.company_name FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN transportation.vehicle_company c ON v.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE v.area_id LIKE '32%' AND t.type_name='客车' AND v.seat_count > 50;

question: 查询广州市天河区注册的所有货车
query: SELECT plate_number FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE v.area_id LIKE '440106%' AND t.type_name='货车';

question: 查询所有船舶及其所属公司名称
query: SELECT v.mmsi, sc.company_name FROM transportation.vessel v JOIN transportation.shipping_company sc ON v.company_id = sc.company_id;

question: 查询所有车辆中，载重量大于15吨的车辆所属公司
query: SELECT DISTINCT c.company_name FROM transportation.vehicle_company c JOIN transportation.vehicle v ON c.company_id = v.company_id WHERE v.load_capacity > 15;

question: 查询济南市注册的所有新能源车数量
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE area_id LIKE '3701%' AND brand LIKE '%电动%';

question: 查询所有车辆中，注册年份在2018年之前的车辆
query: SELECT plate_number FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE YEAR(register_date) < 2018;

question: 查询所有中国籍船舶的详细信息
query: SELECT * FROM transportation.vessel WHERE LEFT(mmsi,3) IN ('412','413','414');

question: 查询所有驾驶员中驾驶车型为'A1'的驾驶员信息
query: SELECT * FROM transportation.driver WHERE license_type = 'A1';

question: 查询所有驾驶员中，驾龄超过20年的驾驶员
query: SELECT name, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, issue_date, CURDATE()) AS experience FROM transportation.driver WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, issue_date, CURDATE()) > 20;

question: 查询所有车辆中，保险到期日在2024年之后的车辆
query: SELECT plate_number FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE insurance_expire > '2024-12-31';

question: 查询每个驾驶员的驾照剩余有效期多少年
query: SELECT name, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, CURDATE(), DATE_ADD(issue_date, INTERVAL valid_years YEAR)) AS remaining_years FROM transportation.driver;

question: 统计各车型的轻型、中型、重型车辆数量
query: SELECT t.type_name, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.load_capacity <= 5 THEN 1 END) AS light, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.load_capacity > 5 AND v.load_capacity <= 15 THEN 1 END) AS medium, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.load_capacity > 15 THEN 1 END) AS heavy FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code GROUP BY t.type_name;

question: 查询福州市注册的车辆中白色的比例
query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN color='白' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*),2) FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE area_id LIKE '3501%';

question: 查询上海市注册的车辆中，新能源车占比
query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN brand LIKE '%电动%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*),2) FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE area_id LIKE '31%';

question: 查询山东省青岛市和济南市的车辆数对比
query: SELECT CASE WHEN area_id LIKE '3701%' THEN '济南' WHEN area_id LIKE '3702%' THEN '青岛' END AS city, COUNT(*) FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE area_id LIKE '3701%' OR area_id LIKE '3702%' GROUP BY city;

question: 查询2025年度所有申报的企业名称
query: SELECT DISTINCT c.company_name FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025;

question: 列出所有技术先进型服务企业的名称
query: SELECT company_name FROM finance_tax.companies WHERE is_tech_advanced_service = TRUE;

question: 查询股票代码以'60'开头的股票名称
query: SELECT stock_name FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE stock_code LIKE '60%';

question: 查询每只股票在2024年最后一个交易日的收盘价
query: SELECT s.stock_name, t.close_price FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date = '2024-12-31';

question: 查询2025年度资产总额超过10亿元的企业
query: SELECT c.company_name, r.total_assets FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND r.total_assets > 100000;

question: 列出所有股票的分红记录年份数
query: SELECT s.stock_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.report_date) FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.dividend_cash > 0 GROUP BY s.stock_name;

question: 查询2025年度扣除金额为0的企业名称
query: SELECT c.company_name FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND r.deductions = 0;

question: 查询股票代码不为空的公司的股票代码和名称
query: SELECT stock_code, company_name FROM finance_tax.companies WHERE stock_code IS NOT NULL;

question: 查询登记注册类型为'有限责任公司'的企业名称
query: SELECT c.company_name FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE rt.type_name = '有限责任公司';

question: 列出所有外商投资企业的名称
query: SELECT c.company_name FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE rt.type_name = '外商投资企业';

question: 查询股价低于10元的股票名称
query: SELECT stock_name FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE current_price < 10;

question: 查询名称带“科技”的民营企业
query: SELECT company_name FROM finance_tax.companies WHERE company_name LIKE '%科技%' AND is_private = TRUE;

question: 查询所有股票市场类别
query: SELECT DISTINCT market_class FROM finance_tax.stocks;

question: 查询所有无记名股票的股票名称
query: SELECT stock_name FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE register_type = 'BEARER';

question: 查询每个行业的公司数量
query: SELECT i.industry_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code GROUP BY i.industry_name ORDER BY cnt DESC;

question: 统计2025年现金分红总额超过1亿元的企业数量
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_tax.company_financials WHERE report_date = '2025-12-31' AND dividend_cash > 10000;

question: 计算每只股票2025年的日均成交量
query: SELECT s.stock_name, AVG(t.volume) FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.stock_name;

question: 查询非民营且非高新技术企业的平均员工人数
query: SELECT AVG(r.employee_count) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_private = FALSE AND c.is_key_high_tech = FALSE;

question: 查询2025年度每月的总成交量（按月汇总）
query: SELECT MONTH(trade_date) AS month, SUM(volume) FROM finance_tax.stock_daily_trades WHERE trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY MONTH(trade_date);

question: 查询合伙企业的平均注册资本
query: SELECT AVG(c.registered_capital) FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE rt.type_name = '合伙企业';

question: 查询上市公司中，规模为大型或中型的公司数量
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_size_category s ON c.size_category_code = s.size_code WHERE s.size_name IN ('大型','中型');

question: 查询所有民营企业的注册类型名称
query: SELECT c.company_name, rt.type_name FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE c.is_private = TRUE;

question: 查询2025年年末的股票收盘价
query: SELECT s.stock_name, t.close_price AS price_end FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31';

question: 统计2025年各股票有多少天收盘价高于开盘价
query: SELECT s.stock_name, COUNT(t.trade_id) FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.close_price > t.open_price AND t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.stock_name;

question: 统计各注册类型企业2025年平均扣除金额
query: SELECT rt.type_name, AVG(r.deductions) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY rt.type_name;

question: 查询非A股的优先股股票
query: SELECT stock_name FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE share_right_type = 'PREFERRED' AND market_class != 'A';

question: 计算2025年度小型微利企业数量占全部申报企业的比例
query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS small_profit_pct FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r WHERE r.tax_year = 2025;

question: 查询2025年度各公司相对于2024年度的收入增长率，列出公司名称及增长率
query: SELECT c.company_name, (r2025.revenue - r2024.revenue) / r2024.revenue * 100 AS growth_rate FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r2025 JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r2024 ON r2025.company_id = r2024.company_id AND r2024.tax_year = 2024 JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r2025.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r2025.tax_year = 2025;

question: 计算所有A股在2025年12月31日的平均市盈率
query: SELECT AVG(t.close_price / (((f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 10000) / s.total_shares)) AS avg_pe FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE s.market_class = 'A' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31';

question: 计算2025年度各企业的红利支付率
query: SELECT c.company_name, (f.dividend_cash / (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 100) AS payout_ratio FROM finance_tax.company_financials f JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON f.company_id = c.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) > 0;

question: 计算每只股票最近一期的股息率
query: SELECT s.stock_name, (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 AS dy FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = (SELECT MAX(report_date) FROM finance_tax.company_financials);

question: 计算每股现金分红金额多少元
query: SELECT s.stock_name, (f.dividend_cash * 10000 / s.total_shares) AS dps FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND f.dividend_cash > 0;

question: 查询总资产周转率最高的前五家企业
query: SELECT c.company_name, r.revenue / NULLIF(r.total_assets,0) AS asset_turnover FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY asset_turnover DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 计算2025年最后一个交易日的个股涨跌幅
query: SELECT s.stock_name, (t.close_price - t.open_price) / t.open_price * 100 AS daily_change FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date = '2025-12-31';

question: 查询收入扣除后利润率最高的前五家企业
query: SELECT c.company_name, (r.revenue - r.deductions) / NULLIF(r.revenue,0) * 100 AS profit_margin FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY profit_margin DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 查询国有企业2025年平均应纳税所得额
query: SELECT AVG(r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND rt.type_name = '国有独资公司';

question: 统计各行业平均资产负债率
query: SELECT i.industry_name, AVG(f.total_liabilities / f.total_assets * 100) FROM finance_tax.company_financials f JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON f.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.industry_name;

question: 请计算平安银行2025年度应纳所得税额
query: SELECT (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25 AS tax_payable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '平安银行' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

question: 请计算招商银行2025年度所得税额占收入的比例
query: SELECT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25 / r.revenue) * 100 AS tax_burden FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '招商银行' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

question: 请计算迈瑞医疗2025年度因享受优惠税率而节省的所得税额
query: SELECT (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.10 AS tax_saved FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '迈瑞医疗' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

question: 请计算上汽集团2025年度所得税额占净利润的比例
query: SELECT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25) / (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 100 AS ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON r.company_id = f.company_id AND r.tax_year = 2025 JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '上汽集团' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31';

question: 请计算中兴通讯2025年度应纳所得税额
query: SELECT (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.15 AS tax_payable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '中兴通讯' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

question: 请计算中国石化2025年度应纳所得税额
query: SELECT (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25 AS tax_payable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '中国石化' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

question: 请计算顺丰速运2025年度净利润和应纳所得税额
query: SELECT (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) AS net_profit, (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25 AS tax_payable FROM finance_tax.company_financials f JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r ON f.company_id = r.company_id AND r.tax_year = 2025 JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON f.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '顺丰速运' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31';

question: 计算中国石化2025年股息率与行业平均股息率的差值有多少百分点
query: SELECT (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 - 6.375 AS diff_pct FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '中国石化' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31';

question: 找出同时满足高新技术和先进型服务的企业，并计算其平均资产总额
query: SELECT AVG(r.total_assets) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_key_high_tech = TRUE AND c.is_tech_advanced_service = TRUE;

question: 在满足小型微利条件的企业中，同时被认定为高新技术企业的占比
query: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS pct FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE;

question: 统计各省级行政区清洁能源发电场站的员工数量占该省电力企业总员工的比例
query: SELECT LEFT(es.area_id,2) AS province_code, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN et.category='清洁能源' THEN e.employee_id END) AS clean_employee_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.employee_id) AS total_employee_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN et.category='清洁能源' THEN e.employee_id END)*100.0/COUNT(DISTINCT e.employee_id) AS clean_pct FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.energy_type_dict et ON es.energy_type_code = et.type_code JOIN energy.employee e ON es.station_id = e.station_id GROUP BY LEFT(es.area_id,2);

question: 统计大型电力企业中拥有硕士及以上学历员工的占比
query: SELECT ec.company_name, SUM(CASE WHEN e.education IN ('硕士','博士') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*) AS master_pct FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.employee e ON ec.company_id = e.company_id WHERE ec.staff_count >= 5000 GROUP BY ec.company_id, ec.company_name;

question: 统计三北地区十四五期间投产的风电和光伏场站总装机容量
query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN energy_type_code='WIND' THEN installed_capacity ELSE 0 END) AS wind_capacity, SUM(CASE WHEN energy_type_code='SOLAR' THEN installed_capacity ELSE 0 END) AS solar_capacity FROM energy.energy_station WHERE LEFT(area_id,2) IN ('11','12','13','14','15','21','22','23','61','62','63','64','65') AND grid_connect_date >= '2021-01-01' AND grid_connect_date <= '2025-12-31';

question: 统计各省份电力企业中拥有双资质的企业数量
query: SELECT LEFT(ec.area_id,2) AS province_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ec.company_id) AS double_cert_count FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.company_certification cc ON ec.company_id = cc.company_id GROUP BY LEFT(ec.area_id,2), ec.company_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cc.cert_type) >= 2;

question: 统计各省份电力企业中总装机容量与员工数量的比值
query: SELECT LEFT(ec.area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(es.installed_capacity)/COUNT(DISTINCT e.employee_id) AS capacity_per_employee FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.energy_station es ON ec.company_id = es.company_id JOIN energy.employee e ON ec.company_id = e.company_id GROUP BY LEFT(ec.area_id,2);

question: 统计各省份电力企业的数量、总员工数和平均员工规模
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,2) AS province_code, COUNT(*) AS company_count, SUM(staff_count) AS total_staff, SUM(staff_count)/COUNT(*) AS avg_staff FROM energy.energy_company GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,2) ORDER BY company_count DESC;

question: 统计三北地区各省份电力企业中年发电量超过装机容量4000小时的超高效火电发电场站数量
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,2) AS province_code, COUNT(*) AS super_thermal_count FROM energy.energy_station WHERE LEFT(area_id,2) IN ('11','12','13','14','15','21','22','23','61','62','63','64','65') AND energy_type_code='THERMAL' AND annual_generation>0 AND installed_capacity>0 AND annual_generation / installed_capacity * 10>4000 GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,2);

query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecommerce.orders WHERE order_channel_code = 'WEB';

question: 帮我按月统计客单价，返回查询结果。
query: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(SUM(payable_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM ecommerce.orders GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month;

question: 统计LIVE渠道的订单数量，返回查询结果。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecommerce.orders WHERE order_channel_code = 'LIVE';

question: 统计支付状态为REFUNDED的支付记录数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM ecommerce.payment WHERE payment_status_code = 'REFUNDED';

question: 请帮我查询销量最高的5个商品，返回查询结果。
query: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity FROM ecommerce.order_item oi JOIN ecommerce.product p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY sales_quantity DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: 帮我按支付方式名称统计支付金额，输出结果。
query: SELECT d.method_name, ROUND(SUM(p.payment_amount), 2) AS pay_amount FROM ecommerce.payment p JOIN common.payment_method_dict d ON p.payment_method_code = d.method_code GROUP BY d.method_code, d.method_name ORDER BY d.method_code;

question: 请统计每个用户的订单数量，输出结果。
query: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM ecommerce.customer c LEFT JOIN ecommerce.orders o   ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY c.customer_id;

question: 统计整体支付成功率，输出结果。
query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status_code = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS payment_success_rate FROM ecommerce.payment;

question: 请帮我统计整体支付成功率，输出结果。
query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status_code = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS payment_success_rate FROM ecommerce.payment;

question: 查询售价高于平均售价的商品，输出结果。
query: SELECT product_id, product_name, sale_price FROM ecommerce.product WHERE sale_price > (SELECT AVG(sale_price) FROM ecommerce.product) ORDER BY product_id;

question: 查询会员等级为DIAMOND的用户。
query: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM ecommerce.customer WHERE level_code = 'DIAMOND' ORDER BY customer_id;

question: 按订单状态名称统计订单数量
query: SELECT d.status_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecommerce.orders o JOIN common.order_status_dict d ON o.order_status_code = d.status_code GROUP BY d.status_code, d.status_name ORDER BY d.status_code;

question: 请帮我统计支付状态为REFUNDED的支付记录数量，输出结果。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM ecommerce.payment WHERE payment_status_code = 'REFUNDED';

question: 统计学术层次为研究生的学生数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS postgrad_cnt FROM education_2024.student s WHERE s.academic_level_code='MASTER';

question: 查询学期编号为1中选课人数最多的第一名课程，返回课程编号与课程名。
query: SELECT x.course_id, x.course_name FROM (SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name) x ORDER BY x.cnt DESC, x.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 统计每个院系的课程数量，并返回院系编号与课程数，按课程数降序取前15个院系。
query: SELECT c.department_id, COUNT(*) AS course_cnt FROM education_2024.course c GROUP BY c.department_id ORDER BY course_cnt DESC, c.department_id ASC LIMIT 15;

question: 统计每个班级在读学生数量，返回班级编号与在读人数，并按人数降序取前20班级。
query: SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(*) AS active_student_cnt FROM education_2024.student s WHERE s.student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND s.class_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.class_id ORDER BY active_student_cnt DESC, s.class_id ASC LIMIT 20;

question: 查询学期编号为2中每门课程的有效选课人数，并按课程编号升序取前10。
query: SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS active_enroll_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id ORDER BY e.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 统计学期一中每门课程的平均考试总评，对无成绩的选课按0计，返回课程编号、课程名与平均总评，按平均总评降序取前10。
query: WITH per_enroll AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e LEFT JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(AVG(p.total_score),2) AS avg_total_score FROM per_enroll p JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY avg_total_score DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 查询学期起止日期键为空或为0的学期记录数，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS semester_date_key_empty_cnt FROM education_2025.semester sem WHERE sem.start_date_key IS NULL OR sem.start_date_key=0 OR sem.end_date_key IS NULL OR sem.end_date_key=0;

question: 统计学期一中每个院系选课人数排名前二的院系，返回院系编号与选课人数，去重学生，按选课人数降序取前2。
query: WITH dept_enroll AS (SELECT c.department_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS active_student_cnt FROM education_2025.course c JOIN education_2025.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND s.student_status_code='ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.department_id) SELECT department_id, active_student_cnt FROM dept_enroll ORDER BY active_student_cnt DESC, department_id ASC LIMIT 2;

question: 查询学期表中起始日期键最小的学期代码，返回学期代码。
query: SELECT sem.semester_code FROM education_2025.semester sem ORDER BY sem.start_date_key ASC, sem.semester_code ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 查询课程学分为5的课程名称列表，按课程名升序取前30。
query: SELECT c.course_name FROM education_2025.course c WHERE c.credit=4 ORDER BY c.course_name ASC LIMIT 30;

question: 统计学期一中所有选课记录的总平均总评折算分，排除退课，返回平均总评。
query: WITH per_enroll AS (SELECT e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.enrollment_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.total_score),2) AS avg_total_score FROM per_enroll p;

question: 查询学期表中结束日期键最大的学期代码，返回学期代码。
query: SELECT sem.semester_code FROM education_2025.semester sem ORDER BY sem.end_date_key DESC, sem.semester_code ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 统计学期一中每门课程的总评折算分中位数，返回课程编号、课程名与中位总评。
query: WITH per_enroll AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), ranked AS (SELECT p.course_id, p.total_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p.course_id ORDER BY p.total_score ASC) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY p.course_id) AS cnt FROM per_enroll p), median_pick AS (SELECT course_id, total_score FROM ranked WHERE rn=FLOOR((cnt+1)/2) OR rn=CEIL((cnt+1)/2)) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(AVG(m.total_score),2) AS median_total_score FROM median_pick m JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=m.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY c.course_id ASC;

question: 查询学期二中每个班级的及格率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回班级编号与及格率百分比，保留两位小数，按及格率降序取前10。
query: WITH per_enroll AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, e.student_id ), per_class AS ( SELECT class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_student_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM per_enroll GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT class_id, ROUND((pass_student_cnt / NULLIF(total_student_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM per_class WHERE class_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, class_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 统计学期一中各课程的报名学生去重人数中，人数最少的排名第一的课程，返回课程编号、课程名与人数。
query: WITH course_enroll AS (SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS active_enroll_student_cnt FROM education_2025.course c JOIN education_2025.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name) SELECT course_id, course_name, active_enroll_student_cnt FROM course_enroll ORDER BY active_enroll_student_cnt ASC, course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 查询学期二中退课记录数，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS withdraw_enrollment_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=2 AND e.is_withdraw=1;

question: 查询课程表中学分为3或4的课程数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_credit_3_or_4_cnt FROM education_2025.course c WHERE c.credit IN (3,4);

question: 比较两年中同学期即学期编号为1的退课学生数是否变化，返回2024退课人数与2025退课人数。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_student_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_student_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1;

question: 找出2024与2025中课程名包含“数据库”的课程，在两年里是否都存在，返回课程名、2024是否存在、2025是否存在。
query: WITH c2024 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT course_id, course_name FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%数据库%' ), c2025 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT course_id, course_name FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%数据库%' ) SELECT COALESCE(a.course_id, b.course_id) AS course_id, COALESCE(a.course_name, b.course_name) AS course_name, CASE WHEN a.course_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2024, CASE WHEN b.course_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2025 FROM c2024 a LEFT JOIN c2025 b ON b.course_id = a.course_id UNION SELECT COALESCE(a.course_id, b.course_id) AS course_id, COALESCE(a.course_name, b.course_name) AS course_name, CASE WHEN a.course_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2024, CASE WHEN b.course_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2025 FROM c2024 a RIGHT JOIN c2025 b ON b.course_id = a.course_id WHERE a.course_id IS NULL;

question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每个班级的及格率，总评不低于60并排除退课，返回及格率在2025上升最多的班级，按2025减2024差值降序取前1。
query: WITH s2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM s2024 GROUP BY class_id ), s2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM s2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT a2025.class_id, ROUND(((a2025.pass_cnt / NULLIF(a2025.total_cnt, 0)) - (a2024.pass_cnt / NULLIF(a2024.total_cnt, 0))) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_diff_pct, ROUND((a2024.pass_cnt / NULLIF(a2024.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct, ROUND((a2025.pass_cnt / NULLIF(a2025.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.class_id = a2025.class_id ORDER BY pass_rate_diff_pct DESC, a2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 找出2024与2025两年中学号一致的学生中，2025在读而2024不在读的学生数量。
query: WITH s2024 AS (SELECT student_id FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE'), s2025 AS (SELECT student_id FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE') SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_in_2025_but_not_2024_cnt FROM s2025 LEFT JOIN s2024 ON s2024.student_id=s2025.student_id WHERE s2024.student_id IS NULL;

question: 判断2024与2025课程表中是否存在学分为0的课程，分别返回数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_zero_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit=0 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_zero_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit=0;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的参与人数，排除退课并去重学生，并返回参与人数在2025增加最多的排名第一的课程，差值等于2025减2024。
query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, (COALESCE(p2025.cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(p2024.cnt_2024,0)) AS diff_participation_cnt, COALESCE(p2024.cnt_2024,0) AS cnt_2024, COALESCE(p2025.cnt_2025,0) AS cnt_2025 FROM p2025 LEFT JOIN p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id LEFT JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_participation_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 统计2024与2025两年中起始日期键不低于20240101的学期中各自有效选课记录数，排除退课，返回两年有效选课记录数。
query: WITH sem2024 AS (SELECT semester_id FROM education_2024.semester WHERE start_date_key>=20240101), sem2025 AS (SELECT semester_id FROM education_2025.semester WHERE start_date_key>=20240101) SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.is_withdraw=0 AND e.semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM sem2024) UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.is_withdraw=0 AND e.semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM sem2025);

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程编号最小值与最大值，返回两年最小值与最大值。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, MIN(course_id) AS min_course_id, MAX(course_id) AS max_course_id FROM education_2024.course UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, MIN(course_id) AS min_course_id, MAX(course_id) AS max_course_id FROM education_2025.course;

question: 统计2024与2025学期一中课程选择人数差，即2025减2024，差值最大的前5门课程，去重学生并排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与差值。
query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COALESCE(p2025.cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(p2024.cnt_2024,0) AS diff_cnt_2025_minus_2024 FROM p2025 LEFT JOIN p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_cnt_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: 查询2024与2025中课程类型为“选修”的课程数量，并返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS elective_course_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='选修' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS elective_course_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='选修';

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的退课人数，这里统计退课标记为1，返回前10门课程的两年退课人数。
query: WITH w2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_student_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id), w2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_student_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COALESCE(w2024.withdraw_student_cnt_2024,0) AS withdraw_student_cnt_2024, COALESCE(w2025.withdraw_student_cnt_2025,0) AS withdraw_student_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course c LEFT JOIN w2025 ON w2025.course_id=c.course_id LEFT JOIN w2024 ON w2024.course_id=c.course_id ORDER BY COALESCE(w2025.withdraw_student_cnt_2025,0) DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程名以“数”开头的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_start_num_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '数%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_start_num_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name LIKE '数%';

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程最高总评折算分的课程，返回两年都存在且最高分相等的课程数量。
query: WITH max2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), agg2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, MAX(total_score) AS max_total_2024 FROM max2024 GROUP BY course_id ), max2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), agg2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, MAX(total_score) AS max_total_2025 FROM max2025 GROUP BY course_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS courses_max_equal_cnt FROM agg2024 a JOIN agg2025 b ON b.course_id = a.course_id WHERE a.max_total_2024 = b.max_total_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025教师工号的数量，不去重并按记录数，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_record_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_record_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中各课程的选课学生平均总评折算分，排除退课，返回两年各课程的平均分对比前10，按2025平均分降序。
query: WITH s2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY course_id), s2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(a2024.avg_total_2024,2) AS avg_total_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025,2) AS avg_total_2025 FROM a2025 LEFT JOIN a2024 ON a2024.course_id=a2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=a2025.course_id ORDER BY avg_total_2025 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中学号前缀为2023的在读学生数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_student_no_prefix_2023_cnt FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND student_no LIKE '2023%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_student_no_prefix_2023_cnt FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND student_no LIKE '2023%';

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中起始日期键的最小值与最大值，返回两年最小值与最大值。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, MIN(start_date_key) AS min_start_date_key, MAX(start_date_key) AS max_start_date_key FROM education_2024.semester UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, MIN(start_date_key) AS min_start_date_key, MAX(start_date_key) AS max_start_date_key FROM education_2025.semester;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个院系的平均选课学生数，按院系的课程汇总的选课人数均值，排除退课，返回两年院系平均选课人数前5，按2025均值降序。
query: WITH e2024 AS (SELECT c.department_id, e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.department_id, e.course_id), a2024 AS (SELECT department_id, AVG(enroll_cnt_2024) AS avg_enroll_per_course_2024 FROM e2024 GROUP BY department_id), e2025 AS (SELECT c.department_id, e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.department_id, e.course_id), a2025 AS (SELECT department_id, AVG(enroll_cnt_2025) AS avg_enroll_per_course_2025 FROM e2025 GROUP BY department_id) SELECT COALESCE(a2024.department_id,a2025.department_id) AS department_id, ROUND(a2024.avg_enroll_per_course_2024,2) AS avg_enroll_per_course_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_enroll_per_course_2025,2) AS avg_enroll_per_course_2025 FROM a2025 LEFT JOIN a2024 ON a2024.department_id=a2025.department_id ORDER BY avg_enroll_per_course_2025 DESC, department_id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: 比较2024与2025学期表里起始日期键为空或为0的学期记录数，返回两年各自数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_start_key_empty_or_zero_cnt FROM education_2024.semester WHERE start_date_key IS NULL OR start_date_key=0 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_start_key_empty_or_zero_cnt FROM education_2025.semester WHERE start_date_key IS NULL OR start_date_key=0;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中课程类型为“必修”的选课人数，排除退课，并返回两年总人数。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, SUM(cnt) AS enroll_student_cnt FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.course_type='必修' GROUP BY e.course_id) t UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, SUM(cnt) AS enroll_student_cnt FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.course_type='必修' GROUP BY e.course_id) t;

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中学期代码相等的数量，学期代码非空且不为0，返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_semester_code_cnt FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' AND semester_code<>'0') a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' AND semester_code<>'0') b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code;

question: 统计2024与2025学期表中结束日期键最大的10个学期代码在两年是否都存在，返回在两年都存在的数量。
query: WITH top2024 AS (SELECT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY end_date_key DESC, semester_code ASC LIMIT 10), top2025 AS (SELECT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY end_date_key DESC, semester_code ASC LIMIT 10) SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_top10_end_date_semester_code_cnt FROM top2024 a JOIN top2025 b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程学分不低于4且课程类型为必修的课程数量，返回两年数量与差值，即2025减2024。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit>=4 AND course_type='必修'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit>=4 AND course_type='必修') SELECT (b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 统计2024与2025两年中学生表里家庭地区编号发生变化的学生数量，同学号对比，返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.student_id) AS home_region_changed_cnt FROM education_2024.student a JOIN education_2025.student b ON b.student_id=a.student_id WHERE COALESCE(a.home_region_id,-1)<>COALESCE(b.home_region_id,-1);

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中课程选课平均人数，排除退课，先对每门课求去重学生数再取平均，返回两年平均选课人数。
query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), per2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG(enroll_student_cnt),2) FROM per2024) AS avg_enroll_students_per_course_2024, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(enroll_student_cnt),2) FROM per2025) AS avg_enroll_students_per_course_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为选修的课程数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='选修'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='选修') SELECT (b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中教师工号数量，不去重，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_rows_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_rows_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher;

question: 找出2024与2025两年共同存在的学生中，按学号，性别不同的学生数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS gender_changed_cnt FROM education_2024.student a JOIN education_2025.student b ON b.student_id=a.student_id WHERE COALESCE(a.gender_code,'')<>COALESCE(b.gender_code,'');

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程名以“数”结尾的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_end_with_数_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%数' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_end_with_数_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%数';

question: 比较2024与2025学生表家庭地区编号为3的在读学生人数，返回两年人数。
query: (SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS student_cnt FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND home_region_id = 3) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS student_cnt FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND home_region_id = 3);

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中结束日期键为空或0的学期数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_end_date_empty_or_zero_cnt FROM education_2024.semester WHERE end_date_key IS NULL OR end_date_key=0 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_end_date_empty_or_zero_cnt FROM education_2025.semester WHERE end_date_key IS NULL OR end_date_key=0;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中总评不低于60的学生去重人数，返回两年人数及差值，即2025减2024。
query: WITH pass2024 AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS pass_students_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id), x2024 AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS pass_students_2024 FROM (SELECT e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id) t WHERE t.total_score>=60), x2025 AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS pass_students_2025 FROM (SELECT e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id) t WHERE t.total_score>=60) SELECT (x2025.pass_students_2025-x2024.pass_students_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, x2024.pass_students_2024, x2025.pass_students_2025 FROM x2024 CROSS JOIN x2025;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为“选修”的数量差，即2025减2024，并返回两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS elective_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='选修'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS elective_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='选修') SELECT b.elective_cnt_2025-a.elective_cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.elective_cnt_2024, b.elective_cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中家庭地区编号为2且性别为女性的在读学生数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND home_region_id=2 AND gender_code='F'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND home_region_id=2 AND gender_code='F') SELECT (b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的通过率，总评不低于60并排除退课，并返回通过率最低的排名第一的课程，两年分别取最低。
query: WITH student_score2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), pass2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt FROM student_score2024 GROUP BY course_id ), student_score2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), pass2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt FROM student_score2025 GROUP BY course_id ) (SELECT '2024' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(p.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM pass2024 p JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct ASC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(p.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM pass2025 p JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct ASC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1);

question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的班级编号，在学期一中选课人数，去重学号，差值前3，即2025减2024。
query: WITH a2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ), a2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ) SELECT a2025.class_id, COALESCE(a2024.enroll_student_cnt_2024, 0) AS enroll_student_cnt_2024, COALESCE(a2025.enroll_student_cnt_2025, 0) AS enroll_student_cnt_2025, COALESCE(a2025.enroll_student_cnt_2025, 0) - COALESCE(a2024.enroll_student_cnt_2024, 0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.class_id = a2025.class_id ORDER BY diff_2025_minus_2024 DESC, a2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 3;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中每个院系编号的课程数量差，即2025减2024，输出差值不为0的院系数量。
query: WITH c2024 AS ( SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS course_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course GROUP BY department_id ), c2025 AS ( SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS course_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course GROUP BY department_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS dept_course_cnt_diff_nonzero_cnt FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(c2024.department_id, c2025.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(c2025.course_cnt_2025, 0) - COALESCE(c2024.course_cnt_2024, 0) AS diff FROM c2024 LEFT JOIN c2025 ON c2025.department_id = c2024.department_id UNION SELECT COALESCE(c2024.department_id, c2025.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(c2025.course_cnt_2025, 0) - COALESCE(c2024.course_cnt_2024, 0) AS diff FROM c2024 RIGHT JOIN c2025 ON c2025.department_id = c2024.department_id WHERE c2024.department_id IS NULL ) t WHERE diff <> 0;

question: 比较2024与2025两年中共同存在的学生中，家庭地区编号在两年都为空或缺失的数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS home_region_both_null_cnt FROM education_2024.student a JOIN education_2025.student b ON b.student_id=a.student_id WHERE (a.home_region_id IS NULL OR a.home_region_id=0) AND (b.home_region_id IS NULL OR b.home_region_id=0);

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程名不为空的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_not_empty_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name IS NOT NULL AND course_name<>'' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_not_empty_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name IS NOT NULL AND course_name<>'';

question: 比较2024与2025学期二每门课程的平均总评折算分，排除退课并按每门课求平均分，返回两年平均总分的差值，即2025减2024。
query: WITH per_enroll2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id ), m2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_course_score_2024 FROM per_enroll2024 GROUP BY course_id ), per_enroll2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id ), m2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_course_score_2025 FROM per_enroll2025 GROUP BY course_id ) SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_course_score_2025), 2) FROM m2025) - (SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_course_score_2024), 2) FROM m2024) AS diff_avg_course_score_2025_minus_2024;

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中学期代码去重后，公共的学期代码数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_semester_code_cnt FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' ) a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' ) b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均参与人数，去重学号后再对课程求平均，返回两年平均值。
query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG(enroll_cnt),2) FROM p2024) AS avg_enroll_students_per_course_2024, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(enroll_cnt),2) FROM p2025) AS avg_enroll_students_per_course_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表课程类型为必修且课程名包含“实验”的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS compulsory_course_name_like_实验_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='必修' AND course_name LIKE '%实验%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS compulsory_course_name_like_实验_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='必修' AND course_name LIKE '%实验%';

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中每个院系编号的课程数量前3，按2025数量降序，返回前3院系编号及两年数量。
query: WITH c2024 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS course_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course GROUP BY department_id), c2025 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS course_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course GROUP BY department_id) SELECT t.department_id, COALESCE(c2024.course_cnt_2024,0) AS course_cnt_2024, t.course_cnt_2025 FROM (SELECT * FROM c2025 ORDER BY course_cnt_2025 DESC, department_id ASC LIMIT 3) t LEFT JOIN c2024 ON c2024.department_id=t.department_id ORDER BY t.course_cnt_2025 DESC, t.department_id ASC;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的选课人数第一名，按2025人数降序，返回课程编号与两年人数。
query: WITH p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, COALESCE(p2024.enroll_cnt_2024,0) AS enroll_cnt_2024, p2025.enroll_cnt_2025 FROM p2025 LEFT JOIN p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY p2025.enroll_cnt_2025 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的课程编号数量，以及这些共同课程中学分不同的数量。
query: WITH common_courses AS (SELECT a.course_id, a.credit AS credit_2024, b.credit AS credit_2025 FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=a.course_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_course_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(credit_2024,-1)<>COALESCE(credit_2025,-1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS common_course_credit_diff_cnt FROM common_courses;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为选修的平均学分，返回两年平均值。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='选修' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='选修';

question: 比较2024与2025课程表课程名包含“数学”的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_like_数学_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%数学%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_like_数学_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%数学%';

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中每个院系编号的课程数量差，即2025减2024，只返回差值不为0的院系编号及差值。
query: WITH c2024 AS ( SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course GROUP BY department_id ), c2025 AS ( SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course GROUP BY department_id ) SELECT COALESCE(c2025.department_id, c2024.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025, 0) - COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024, 0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM c2024 LEFT JOIN c2025 ON c2024.department_id = c2025.department_id UNION SELECT COALESCE(c2025.department_id, c2024.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025, 0) - COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024, 0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM c2024 RIGHT JOIN c2025 ON c2024.department_id = c2025.department_id WHERE c2024.department_id IS NULL;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的退课率，退课去重学生除以选课去重学生，返回退课率最高的课程，两年分别给出课程编号与退课率。
query: WITH b2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), r2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_students_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_students_cnt FROM b2024 GROUP BY course_id ), b2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), r2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_students_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_students_cnt FROM b2025 GROUP BY course_id ) (SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((r.withdraw_students_cnt / NULLIF(r.total_students_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM r2024 r JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = r.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((r.withdraw_students_cnt / NULLIF(r.total_students_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM r2025 r JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = r.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1);

question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的班级数，按班级编号，并计算共同班级中性别不同的学生数，去重学号。
query: WITH common_classes AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s2024.class_id FROM education_2024.enrollment e2024 JOIN education_2024.student s2024 ON s2024.student_id = e2024.student_id JOIN education_2025.enrollment e2025 ON e2025.student_id = e2024.student_id AND e2025.semester_id = e2024.semester_id JOIN education_2025.student s2025 ON s2025.student_id = e2025.student_id AND s2025.class_id = s2024.class_id ), common_students AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s2024.student_id, s2024.gender_code AS gender_2024, s2025.gender_code AS gender_2025 FROM education_2024.enrollment e2024 JOIN education_2024.student s2024 ON s2024.student_id = e2024.student_id JOIN education_2025.enrollment e2025 ON e2025.student_id = e2024.student_id AND e2025.semester_id = e2024.semester_id JOIN education_2025.student s2025 ON s2025.student_id = e2025.student_id WHERE s2024.class_id = s2025.class_id ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM common_classes) AS common_class_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(gender_2024, '') <> COALESCE(gender_2025, '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gender_diff_common_student_cnt FROM common_students;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均总评折算分，排除退课，并返回两年平均值之差，即2025减2024。
query: WITH s2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_course_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY course_id), s2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_course_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(avg_total_course_2025) FROM a2025) - (SELECT AVG(avg_total_course_2024) FROM a2024),2) AS diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中院系编号在两年都存在的部门，返回这些院系编号及两年课程数差值，即2025减2024。
query: WITH c2024 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course GROUP BY department_id), c2025 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course GROUP BY department_id) SELECT c2025.department_id, c2024.cnt_2024, c2025.cnt_2025, c2025.cnt_2025-c2024.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM c2025 JOIN c2024 ON c2024.department_id=c2025.department_id ORDER BY diff_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c2025.department_id ASC;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为必修的学分平均值差，即2025减2024，返回均值与差值。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT AVG(credit) AS avg_credit_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='必修'), b AS (SELECT AVG(credit) AS avg_credit_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='必修') SELECT ROUND(b.avg_credit_2025-a.avg_credit_2024,2) AS diff_avg_credit_2025_minus_2024, ROUND(a.avg_credit_2024,2) AS avg_credit_2024, ROUND(b.avg_credit_2025,2) AS avg_credit_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 查询IMO编号不为空且船舶类型为油轮（80）的所有记录。

question: 查询今天所有记录的AIS数据

question: 查询今天船舶类型为货船（vessel_type=70）且速度低于3节的记录。

question: 查询在2024年6月1日，吃水深度小于6米或大于12米的船舶MMSI和吃水值。

question: 查询今天速度超过20节且航向在90到180度之间的船舶，返回mmsi和最大速度。
query: SELECT mmsi, MAX(sog) AS max_speed FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE sog > 20 AND cog BETWEEN 90 AND 180 AND timestamp::date = CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY mmsi

question: 查询目的地中不包含'PORT'（不区分大小写）的所有AIS记录
query: SELECT * FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE destination NOT ILIKE '%PORT%'

question: 查询目的地中包含'SEA'（不区分大小写）的AIS记录
query: SELECT * FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE destination ILIKE '%SEA%'

question: 显示船舶 351000004 的最新位置

question: 查询MMSI为412000123的船舶所有记录，按其最后更新时间降序排列。
query: SELECT * FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi = 412000123 ORDER BY last_update DESC

question: 获取今天船舶类型为货船（70）或油轮（80）的记录，按船舶类型升序、速度降序排列，取前20条。
query: SELECT * FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE timestamp::date = CURRENT_DATE AND vessel_type IN (70, 80) ORDER BY vessel_type ASC, sog DESC LIMIT 20

question: 查询最新10条数据
query: SELECT * FROM vessel_ais_data ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 10

question: 显示船舶 351000007 最近 3 次状态变更记录
query: SELECT * FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi = 351000007 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 3

question: 列出船舶MMSI为351000001的所有记录，按时间戳升序排列。
query: SELECT * FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi = 351000001 ORDER BY timestamp ASC

question: 对于MMSI为351000001的船舶，计算其在2024年6月1日每小时的平均速度，并按小时升序显示。
query: SELECT date_trunc('hour', timestamp) AS hour, AVG(sog) AS avg_speed FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi = 351000001 AND timestamp::date = '2024-06-01' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

question: 按船舶类型统计今天的平均速度，并按平均速度降序排列。
query: SELECT vessel_type, AVG(sog) AS avg_speed FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE timestamp::date = CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY vessel_type ORDER BY avg_speed DESC

question: 按航行状态分组，统计每种航行状态下的船舶记录数量。
query: SELECT nav_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM vessel_ais_data GROUP BY nav_status

question: 查询吃水深度大于所有货船平均吃水深度的船舶记录
query: SELECT * FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE draught > (SELECT AVG(draught) FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE vessel_type = 70)

question: 查询在最近24小时内曾经速度超过20节的船舶的当前最新记录
query: SELECT * FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE id IN (SELECT MAX(id) FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi IN (SELECT DISTINCT mmsi FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hour' AND sog > 20) GROUP BY mmsi)

question: 检索至少上报过5次AIS数据的船舶MMSI
query: SELECT mmsi FROM vessel_ais_data GROUP BY mmsi HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

question: 查询目的地与MMSI为417000001的船舶最新上报的目的地相同的船舶，返回MMSI和目的地。
query: SELECT DISTINCT mmsi, destination FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE destination = (SELECT destination FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi = 417000001 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AND mmsi <> 417000001

question: 查询MMSI为412000123的船舶最新位置周围3公里内，航行状态为锚泊的其他船舶。
query: WITH target_pos AS (SELECT geom FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi = 412000123 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT DISTINCT ON (v.mmsi) v.* FROM vessel_ais_data v, target_pos t WHERE v.mmsi != 412000123 AND v.nav_status = 1 AND ST_DWithin(v.geom::geography, t.geom::geography, 3000) ORDER BY v.mmsi, v.timestamp DESC

question: 查询最新位置与MMSI为414000001的船舶最新位置距离10公里以内，且船舶类型为货船的其他船舶。
query: WITH target AS (SELECT geom FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi=414000001 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1), latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (mmsi) * FROM vessel_ais_data ORDER BY mmsi,timestamp DESC) SELECT v.* FROM latest v CROSS JOIN target t WHERE v.mmsi!=414000001 AND v.vessel_type=70 AND ST_DWithin(v.geom::geography,t.geom::geography,10000)
curation_reason: 先按每船取真正最新记录，再判断距离；不得用范围内旧位置代替最新位置。

question: 检索最新位置与MMSI为412000111的最新位置相距5公里以内的船舶，仅返回MMSI、经度、纬度、速度和航向字段。
query: WITH target_pos AS (SELECT geom FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi = 412000111 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT DISTINCT ON (v.mmsi) v.mmsi, v.longitude, v.latitude, v.sog, v.cog FROM vessel_ais_data v, target_pos t WHERE v.mmsi != 412000111 AND ST_DWithin(v.geom::geography, t.geom::geography, 5000) ORDER BY v.mmsi, v.timestamp DESC

question: 计算离(121.5, 31.2)这个点6公里范围内，各目的地船舶的吃水深度总和和平均吃水深度。
query: SELECT destination, SUM(draught) AS total_draught, AVG(draught) AS avg_draught FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE ST_DWithin(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(121.5, 31.2), 4326)::geography, 6000) GROUP BY destination

question: 计算过去24小时内，距离(121.5, 31.2)点15公里以内的船舶中，每艘船出现在该区域的时间跨度，并按跨度降序显示前5艘船。
query: SELECT mmsi, MAX(timestamp) - MIN(timestamp) AS duration FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND ST_DWithin(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(121.5, 31.2), 4326)::geography, 15000) GROUP BY mmsi ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 5

question: 检索最近48小时内，位于(120.8, 30.5)周围3公里圆形区域内的船舶，按时间戳升序排列。

question: 在2024年6月1日10:00至14:00期间，找出在(121.5, 31.2)周围3公里圆形区域内速度最快的3艘航行中的船舶

question: 查询今天上午0点到12点，在(114.1,22.4)、(114.2,22.4)、(114.15,22.5)三角形区域内，目的地为'QINGDAO'且吃水超过8米的船舶。

question: 查询昨天下午2点到8点之间，在由(121.0,30.9)、(121.2,30.8)、(121.4,31.0)、(121.3,31.2)、(121.1,31.1)五个点围成的五边形区域内，记录数大于2条且时间跨度在10到30分钟之间的船舶，返回这些船舶的MMSI码以及对应的时间跨度。
query: SELECT mmsi, MAX(timestamp) - MIN(timestamp) AS time_span FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE timestamp::date = CURRENT_DATE - 1 AND timestamp::time BETWEEN '14:00:00' AND '20:00:00' AND ST_Within(geom, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((121.0 30.9, 121.2 30.8, 121.4 31.0, 121.3 31.2, 121.1 31.1, 121.0 30.9))', 4326)) GROUP BY mmsi HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 AND MAX(timestamp) - MIN(timestamp) BETWEEN INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND INTERVAL '30 minutes'

question: 检索过去24小时内，进入由(113.3,22.1)、(113.5,22.0)、(113.6,22.2)、(113.4,22.4)、(113.2,22.3)五点围成的多边形区域，且进入后在该区域内的航行状态始终为航行中(0)并停留超过10分钟的船舶，返回船舶MMSI以及其在该区域内的首次和末次记录时间。
query: SELECT mmsi, MIN(timestamp) AS start_t, MAX(timestamp) AS end_t FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND ST_Within(geom, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((113.3 22.1, 113.5 22.0, 113.6 22.2, 113.4 22.4, 113.2 22.3, 113.3 22.1))', 4326)) GROUP BY mmsi HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN nav_status != 0 THEN 1 END) = 0 AND MAX(timestamp) - MIN(timestamp) > INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND MIN(timestamp) > (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(timestamp), '1970-01-01') FROM vessel_ais_data a2 WHERE a2.mmsi = vessel_ais_data.mmsi AND a2.timestamp < MIN(vessel_ais_data.timestamp) AND NOT ST_Within(a2.geom, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((113.3 22.1, 113.5 22.0, 113.6 22.2, 113.4 22.4, 113.2 22.3, 113.3 22.1))', 4326)))

question: 查询今天在由(121.3,31.0)、(121.5,31.0)、(121.4,31.2)三点围成的三角形区域内所有船舶的最新AIS记录，按速度降序排列，返回船舶MMSI、航速、经纬度及时间。
query: SELECT mmsi, sog, longitude, latitude, timestamp FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (mmsi) mmsi, sog, longitude, latitude, timestamp FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE timestamp::date = CURRENT_DATE AND ST_Within(geom, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((121.3 31.0, 121.5 31.0, 121.4 31.2, 121.3 31.0))', 4326)) ORDER BY mmsi, timestamp DESC) sub ORDER BY sog DESC

question: 计算今天MMSI为416000001的油轮与MMSI为412000555的货船最新位置之间的直线距离。
query: WITH s1 AS (SELECT geom FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi = 416000001 AND timestamp::date = CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1), s2 AS (SELECT geom FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi = 412000555 AND timestamp::date = CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT ST_Distance(s1.geom::geography, s2.geom::geography) AS distance FROM s1, s2

question: 在最近24小时内，查找距(118.7, 20.1)最近且速度高于10节的油轮，返回前3艘的MMSI与距离。

question: 查询MMSI为413000001的船舶在最近24小时内的轨迹点序列。

question: 查找今天轨迹经过距(114.0,22.5) 10公里范围内的油轮的MMSI。

question: 1994年哪些图书的订单数量低于平均水平？列出书名、类型和价格。

question: 美国出版社和非美国出版社出版的图书，平均版税差多少？
query: SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.country = 'USA' THEN T1.royalty ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.country = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) - (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.country != 'USA' THEN T1.royalty ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.country != 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) FROM book_publishing_company.titles AS T1 INNER JOIN book_publishing_company.publishers AS T2 ON T1.pub_id = T2.pub_id INNER JOIN book_publishing_company.roysched AS T3 ON T1.title_id = T3.title_id
